column2: Sicilian Invasion - June 10th, 1943
The Western Allies land in Sicily. The Axis powers try to throw them into the sea.
Herr General the western allies have invaded Sicily. You have to throw them into the sea before is too late. The loyalty of our Italian allies is at stake!!!
Herr General, I am sorry that the sacrifice of your fine troops have been in vain. You have been ordered to Berlin. I do not envy your reception there.

Excellent! The spy has been quickly extracted, and the area secured.  Soon we shall find out what he has learned over the past three months. The Germans are impressed with your tactics and are now calling you the "Blitzkrieg" General.
You have dealt the Red Army a crippling blow. With our line shortened, we will be able to transfer a large number of  troops to Feldmarschall von Paulus at Stalingrad. Superlative work, Herr General.

Kongratulieren!, our elite paratroopers have showed they skills again. The entrance of the Kanal is secured, the British won't be able to use it anymore to resupply their units in Egypt and the Middle East.
ALLIES ON THE MARCH - US SIDE
Allies On The March - US Side

You act the role of a promising talent within the US Army. If successful, your career will cover the major theatres of operations during WW2, leaving your elite troops the hardest work on the way from Africa to the heart of the Third Reich. Then you will be challenged even more by a new 15 scenarios extra-campaign against the Soviets. 48 scenarios, a lot of new maps to play, increasing difficulty during the campaign: persuade Washington that you are the rising military leader of the United States Army!
PG2 Campaign Designer: Andrea Bigi, 04/04/2004
PeG-WW2 Campaign: Michael Nowak, 24/06/2010
PeG-WW2 campaign adaptations: Robert Mary, 24/06/2010

You act the role of a promising talent within the US Army. If successful, your career will cover the major theatres of operations during WW2, leaving your elite troops the hardest work on the way from Africa to the heart of the Third Reich. [Then you will be challenged even more by a new 15 scenarios extra-campaign against the Soviets. 48 scenarios, a lot of new maps to play, increasing difficulty during the campaign: persuade Washington that you are the rising military leader of the United States Army!]

Welcome to Africa, commander! You have been selected to join the Patton Western Task Force in Operation Torch. A few part of your core force has just landed the Moroccan coast, but you'll have to debark quickly the rest of your army in order to accomplish successfully this
mission. Casablanca is our ultimate objective: expect heavy resistance by the French only there. Also pay attention for the enemy vessels. Good luck.

Welcome to Africa, commander! You have been selected to join the Patton Western Task Force in Operation Torch. A few part of your core force has just landed the Moroccan coast, but you'll have to debark quickly the rest of your army in order to accomplish successfully this mission. Casablanca is our ultimate objective: expect heavy resistance by the French only there. Also pay attention for the enemy vessels. Good luck.

This operation has been a toal fiasco from the start. The United States Army doesn't have the time or the patience to put up with such ineptitude. Do me a personal favor and get outta here. Dismissed!
Commander, you got the job done.  Unfortunately, we lost a lot of GIs to accompplish this mission. Anyway you did your best, so you'll be given another chance to prove yourself.
Operation Torch - The Advance

Commander, Port Lyautey is the final objective for you here in Morocco. With this port in our hands, we'll be able to race to the east towards the Krauts in Tunisia. Once again you will be supported by our powerful ships and a small contingent of marines. You have to expect poor resistance from the French garrisons, by the way we are in a hurry. Do not waste your time!
Commander, this will certainly earn you another medal! The capture of Port Lyautey has been really an amazing job. Now we must race to the east towards the Krauts in Tunisia.
Well, your performance was not so good, commander, but you did your best and you will be given another chance to prove yourself. Good luck.
You were brilliant! It is time to celebrate: the Axis has been totally defeated in Africa. Now I want you and your men to get some badly needed rest. Soon we will meet again.
I don't know a diplomatic way to say this, commander. Your performance has been really awful, you will not see again the battlefield for a long time!
Well, what can I say?  You did manage to secure your objectives as well as capture a few  Jerries. A comparatively successful performance, commander, but you could do much better!
Volchansk  - June 4th, 1942
Strock: Herr General, I want you to capture the political prisoners camps in Volchansk. Good luck.

Commander, you struck out here, and good men died because of it.  We're lucky the Krauts didn't kick us back to Morocco! I guess you need some time for rest and refit before coming back into service...
Due to everyone's success in this campaign, the Russian push West has been stopped. Well done Herr General !!
Great great job, commander! We dropped you into a real mess, but you came out smelling like a rose. The fighting was tough, but your boys hung in there.
It's a pity, commander. It seems that the Desert Fox is still too tough for your boys. Do not be afraid, you will have another opportunity to show your talent.
Good job, commander! We dropped you into a real mess, but you came out smelling like a rose. The fighting was tough, but your boys hung in there.
We had restore all colonies of our ally and we control the whole Red Sea, but we have to gain another strong point controlled by the British: Mombasa.
Gazala line (Unternehmen Theseus)
It's really a disgrace. You had everything you needed to win this battle, but you managed to lose. Report to HQ immediately!
You were not as brilliant as we expected from you, but you did it at last. Now It is time to celebrate because the Axis has been totally defeated in Africa.
Smolensk-Crossing the Dniepr July1941 TV
You have successfully crossed the Dniepr, but you have lost valuable time. All chances of encircling the Russian forces are gone.
Remarkable job, commander. The Axis forces have been completely annihilated. Now let's keep the initiative to occupy fast all the island.
Shit, what a punishing loss! If we weren't so short of trained officers, you would be on your way back to the States right now.
You complete your mission on schedule, commander, but the Axis has been able to hit your landing forces much more than expected. Next time you should try to keep the casualties down.
You have been defeated, but at least you've tried. Now the allies has overrun the Gustav Line and you must retreat to the Gothic Line.
Commander, you did a wonderful job in a tough situation. Your leadership was a key element in demolishing the Axis defences.
We really needed a knockout blow here, Commander. Instead, you put up a weak little jab. Our boys are fighters, son, but we need a general who can lead them!
Commander, the stubborn defence put up by the Nazi has been a sort of nightmare for your assaulting troops, but at last you did it. Now please rest and refit for a while.
Herr General: You achieved a great victory !!!. It will take a long time before the Russians can take the offensive here.

Commander, as you know Italy has just surrendered. In combination with the announcement of the armistice we have launched Operation Avalanche, our landing assault to the shores nearby the city of Salerno, not so far from Naples. Anyway, the Krauts look absolutely not surprised by the Italian surrender and our landing at Salerno. They have mustered a strong reaction force around our beachheads, so you will need all of your talent to survive the german counterattack, fortify your positions and then advance towards Naples. Good luck!

Commander, as you know Italy has just surrendered. In combination with the announcement of the armistice we have launched Operation Avalanche, our landing assault to the shores nearby the city of Salerno, not far from Naples. Anyway, the Krauts look absolutely not surprised by the Italian surrender and our landing at Salerno. They have mustered a strong reaction force around our beachheads, so you will need all of your talent to survive the German counterattack, fortify your positions and then advance towards Naples. Good luck!
The fighting on the beaches of Salerno was clearly too tough for your boys. Now we have a big problem here in southern Italy. You need a period of rest and refit, commander.
The fighting on the beaches of Salerno was maybe too tough for your boys, commander, but you managed to win. Now you need a period of rest and refit.
Good work, commander! Now, we've got men and machines rolling into central Italy. Next stop maybe is Rome. Nice going.
What a disaster! We thought the Germans were licked and they have been able to smash even your elite army. All the HQ is very disappointed.
At last you did it, commander, but we really paid too much. Next time try to limit the casualties using a better strategy on the battlefield.
You have selected the path towards North Afrika, you will have to resist to increasingly powerful Allies.
St. Huber
Wiltz Flughafen
Not bad, commander, but we're going to have to do better in the next one, or it's going to be a long war. Now you better rest and refit for a while.
Herr General you achieved a magnificient victory against heavy odds. !!! The drive into Germany has been stopped !!!
Commander, congratulations and accolades on a mission well done! Your troops certainly gave the Germans everything that they deserved and more!
Strock: The General Staff is very unhappy with your lucklaster performance Herr General! You need to do better or you are going to be replaced!
A spectacular victory, even against all odds! Looks like you might get another star for this one. I heard you were right up there with your boys!  Good job, good job, son.
It's a shame, commander! After your disappointing performance it would be difficult to have you in the vicinity without choking on my crumpet.
A good performance, commander, but the brass seems to think you could have moved a lot faster than you did. Don't worry, we'll get them next time.
A spectacular victory, even against all odds! Looks like you might get another star for this one. I heard you were right up there with your boys! Good job, good job, son.
Brilliant Job, commander. The German defences at Cassino were very tough to crack, but you did it even faster than scheduled. Congratulations!

Getting past Cassino and beyond the Gustav Line was simply critical for this Italian campaign. Instead, we're still bogged down. There's no time for fooling around; we're going to have to go this thing all over again.
Congratulations Herr General your victory here has stopped the Americans. Our African Army can now be evacuated to defend Southern Europe.
A properly planned amphibious assault, supported by massive naval
gunfire, was difficult if not impossible to repel. At Salerno, the Germans,
who didn't know this, almost crushed the beachhead and might have
done so with just slightly better luck.
Number of scenarios: 31
Stalingrad Counterattack - November 20th, 1942
The German player tries to release the 6th Army encircled in Stalingrad.

Herr General, we have underestimated the Bolsheviks' powers of resistance. They have crossed the Don and completely encircled Sixth Army. You must drive on Kletskaya and Serafimov to reestablish contact. We will never, never surrender to the Red Army, but in order for us to hold our position, you must prevail. Good Luck.                                                    \x00
Pantelleria - March 3rd, 1943
The Axis powers try to recover Pantelleria island taken by the Western Allies.
Strock: Herr General The Western Allies have taken the island of Pantelleria outside the cost of Africa.  It is a direct threat to Sicily !!! You have to retake it.
Tunisia - January 7th, 1943
The Axis powers try to stop the Western Allies drive into Tunis.
Strock: Herr General the Americans have invaded Africa.  You should help the Afrika Korps to hold the line. A defeat there will threaten Italy directly.
Don Front - December 7th, 1942
The Russians break the Axis troops front in the Don river. The Germans counterattack to restore the front.
Strock: Herr General you have an opportunity to clear yourself. The Russians have broken our allies front accross the Don river. You should restore the situation !!!
Mussolini's Rescue - September 2nd, 1943
The Germans try to rescue Mussolini jailed in the Abruzzi.

Herr General the General Staff has orderred Mussolini to be release from prison at all costs. We are assemblying a especial team to do the job. I was thinking of that ex-SS officer that serves under you. Otto Skorzeny is his name I believe...
Kerch - August 11th, 1943
The Russians try to cross the Kerch straits to invade Crimea.
Herr General you dealt a mighty blow to the Russians.  We will have a quiet Southern front for a long time.
Lgt CR Jean De Vienne
Good work by your elite division Bob.
With the help of the 14th Armoured Division all the town is in our hands now and some prisoners were taken.
Zhitomir - October 7th, 1943
The Russians attack Zhitomir trying to break the link between Army Groups Center and South.

Herr General the Russians are trying to break in the northern part of Army Group South. If they succeed the link between Army Groups Center and South will be broken. Gomel is threatened. Stop them before is too late !!!
The Germans try to eliminate the Kursk bulge.
Herr General, you got to break through the Soviet's iron grip and seize the city of Kursk. Good luck !!!
Dniepr Crossing - November 1st, 1943
The Russians try to cross the Dniepr river. It is the last great geographical barrier to German controlled territory.
Herr General, The Russians are trying to cross the Dnepr river, the last barrier to Western Ukraine. You should prevented this. You will need your bridging units !!!
Orel Bulge - August 20th, 1943
During the Zitadelle Operation the Russians took Orel. The Germans try to recover the city after their success in Zitadelle.
Herr General, the Russians during Operation Zitadelle took the Orel Bulge. After your victory there you need to retake Orel to stabilize Army Group Center front.
Cherkassy - February 9th, 1944
The Russians isolate a German Infantry Corps in Cherkassy, Ukraine.  The Germans counterattack to break the encirclement.
Herr General the Russians are attacking Army Group Northen Ukraine. A reinforced infantry Corps is encircled in Cherkassy.  You have to break the circle and release these troops !!!
Western Ukraine - April 18th, 1944
The Russians try to expel the Germans from Western Ukraine. The action starts after they have broken the German front.
Herr General the I and II Ukrainian Fronts have broken our lines in the Ukraine. Kiev the Ukraine capital is threatened.  Several of our garrisons are isolated.  You have to stop them !!!
Sevastopol Evacuation - May 17th, 1944
The Germans and Romanians fight desperately to gain time for the 17th Army to evacuate Sevastopol.

Herr General the 17th Army is in a completely desperate position inside Sevastopol. It is surrounded by overwhelmingly superior Russian forces. We organized an evacuation, but we need time desperately to be successful.
Note: This is a very difficult scenario, victory is achieved only by a careful combination of factors.  Speed is essential. Think carefully.
Normandy - June 7th, 1944
The Germans counterattack to destroy the Allies beachheads.
Herr General, the Western Allies have landed in Normandy. We need to drive them to the sea !!!
Viipuri Counterattack - June 15th, 1944
The Russians defeated the Finns at Viipuri. A combined German-Finnish Army counterattacks to recover Viipuri.
Herr General bad news. The Russians have defeated the Finnish at Viipuri !!!. If we do not successfully counterattack Finland will sue for peace. We count on you Herr General !!!
Red Avalanche - September 7th, 1944
The Russians invade the Baltic states and Northern Poland. The Germans try to stop their onslaught.
Herr General, the 1st and 2nd Belorussian Fronts threaten Vilna, Riga and the Reich itself in East Prussia. You should defend the sacred soil of the Fatherland!!!
Battle of the Bulge - December 7th, 1944
The Germans attack to cut the Western Allies Front in two.  Bastogne and St. Vith are their objectives.
Herr General : Pardon me ! Herr Feld-Marschall.  The Americans have created an opening in their advance toward the Reich border. You should cut their lines and reach Antwerp on the channel coast.

Nordwind - December 30th, 1944
The Germans attack the American and French forces near Strasbourg.
Herr Feld-Marschall. You should complete the job by defeating the Americans in the Southern part of the front. Strasbourg should be retaken!!!
Operation Konrad - January 14th, 1945
The Hungarian capital of Budapest is besieged by the Red Army.  The Germans must break through the Soviet lines to help their last remaining ally and repel the soviets.
Herr General the Russians are besieging Budapest. We need to relieve the city or the Hungarians will abandon the war.
Budapest - January 21st, 1945
The Russians have isolated Budapest the Hungarian Capital. The Germans counterattack to break the ring surrounding the City.

Herr General: The 3rd Ukrainian Front has completed surrounded Budapest. The Hungarians and some of our troops resist bravely inside the city.  They can not hold for long. Relieve them Herr General!!!
The Battle for Berlin - April 4th, 1945
The Russians attack the German Capital from the East and South.  Germans try desperately to stop the Russian onslaught.

Herr Feld-Marschall.  The Russians threaten Berlin. Zhukov is about to break the Oder Front and Konev has already broken the 3rd Panzer army lines in the South. You are the only one who can stop them !!! You are in the direct path of Konev.  Feld Marschall Rommel came out of retirement to raise a Panzer Corps to slow down Zhukov.  He will try to buy some time for you. You should defeat Konev first and then Zhukov.
Summer Storm - June 15th, 1945
The Germans try to liberate Eastern Germany and the Baltic coast from the Russian occupation. Objectives: Danzig, Konisberg and Memel.

Glorius news Herr Feld-Marschall!!! Marschal Model has taken Breslau ejecting the Russians from Silesia and southern Poland.  It is your turn to purge of invaders the sacred soil of the Fatherland!!! Attack towards Konigsberg and the Baltic coast. End this war Herr Feld-Marschall!!!
Longest path: 16

This 16 scenarios long linear campaign is designed for skilled players whereas the 31 scenario long "Reich defense" campaign (17 scenarios longest path) is easier and includes what if scenarios. Both campaigns were designed in order to enhance original SSI "Defending the Reich" campaign.
The Western Allies, with the help of the newly formed German Territorial Force, have recaptured Berlin, and are attempting to drive the Soviets back across the Oder.
BAND OF BROTHERS
Band of Brothers
US Campaign: 1944-1945
Campaign designer: Doug Hone, 2003
This campaign follows the battles of the 506th Parachute Infantry Regiment of the US 101st Airborne Division from D Day to VE Day.
You play as the Regimental Commander:
Colonel Robert F Sink.
Happy Hunting.
I'm surprised that your men have let you down this way Bob, maybe they are not yet ready for action.
Washington'46 - March 21st, 1946
Herr Feld-Marschall the USA Capital is in front of you. The American resistance is extremely tough, but you should prevail!!! End this war Herr Feld-Marschall!!!
Due to heavy flak and pilot error your troops were scattered and now they face the difficult task of forming up in time for your next mission. Good Luck.
Our fortune has changed, a massive soviet counter-offensive has destroyed our army and invaded Poland as well as East-Prussia.
Three Soviet armies attack on Dubno and Lutsk cities. Your forces must bring a stop to Ivan.

I'm impressed.  Boy, you really earned your pay.  Now we've got some elbow room, which means we can get to work liberating France. Commander, I've got a special job for you. We need you over in Caen. The Krauts have really dug in there and we need someone who can kick some tail so we can get a move on.
Congratulations on your Regiment's success!! We have protected the beach-head and also cleared up a significant pocket of resistance. Well done!
Once again your mistakes heve been covered, this time by the 4th Infantry Division. We will be looking for much improvement if you are to keep your post Bob!!!!

Commander, you have been a disappointment to King and country.  It was necessary to drive through Metz and move on, but instead, we find ourselves sandbagged in the trenches!  Our brave lads will capture Metz, I assure you, but it will be done with a different commander.  Good day.
So the snipers scared off your men Bob?? Well luckily the 401st GIB took your objective for you. Now we can attack over the river.
Operation Rumintzev (RTB#8)
KempGroup HQ
69 HQ

Although your men failed to take their objective the 502nd PIR and 401st GIR did the job for you. The 101st Division has captured the strategically important town of Carentan and now we can link with the assault force coming inland from Omaha Beach.

You were lucky 2nd Pz and 10th Pz divisions captured your targets. Vayzma and Gzhatsk are in our hands now. Again 100,000s of Russians are trapped in pockets behind our lines. Partisan activity makes it increasingly difficult to operate from the airfields close to the front (That's why the airfields did not offer resupply). Now it's time to move East. Moscow is the target. Let's hope we have not lost too much time. Intelligence reports Siberian troops have arrived at the front already.
So far so good Bob!! Although not all the objectives were taken we will be bulstered by the assistance of the 30th Corps for the next stage of operations.
Although not all our objectives were taken and/or held we are confident that with more of the 2nd Armies tanks and heavy weapons moving north that the operation can still be successful.

Although you held open parts of the road, the British 1st Airborne Division was devastated at Arnhem. The battle has not been declared a total failure, but we doubt the Airborne Divisions will be used in this capacity again in this war.

Although your Regiment didn't hold the line successfully the Germans have been held along the rest of the northern front line and we are in a good position to strike a blow to the heart of the Third Reich.
Although you failed to make it to Bastogne in time the German attack has faultered and we are on the offensive once more.
Thankfully you were able to hold out long enough for the 4th Armoured Division to breakthrough and relieve you.
Unfortunately you have no time to rest as we still need your troops to help push back the German front.
Sorry to hear that most of your men were either killed or captured Bob. I hope they are comfortable in their POW camp until we can liberate them.
Thanks to our combined divsions the Germans are on the run now!!

Congratulations on your capture of Vyborg. The Finns have sued for peace, but they have declared neutrality and will maintain their archaic capitalist system.  And now, if you will excuse me, I have work to do.
The southern half of Haguenau is in our hands now and we are poised to enter the Reich.
With the help of the 14th Armoured Division all the town and several other villages are now in our hands and many prisoners were taken.
All the town is in our hands now and we are poised to enter the Reich.
So you have joined your men behind barbed wire Bob!!
Looks like the war is over for you!!

That was not good General,
You failed to cutoff Berlin making Monty's job significantly harder.
He got the job done but I wouldn't go visit our English friends for a while
if I were you.

With the help of the 14th Armoured Division all the town is in our hands now and many prisoners were taken.
It looks as if your Division won't be needed in the Pacific theatre after all so let your men relax and enjoy some time in Austria.
